card.text: Explore Makemake with an illustrative NASA surface texture and its distant orbit around the Sun.

introduction.text: Makemake is a distant, reddish dwarf planet with one known moon. Its surface is shown using NASA’s illustrative model texture; no spacecraft has mapped it.

illustration.title: Surface illustration
illustration.summary: The depicted terrain is imagined, not photographed. The real surface is unresolved, and the displayed coordinates are arbitrary.
